visual_goal: Show every partner client, human or machine, passing through one gateway and the same authorization before reaching supply, ARI, reservations and finance services.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Far left, four client boxes stacked: a laptop labeled 'Extranet', a phone labeled 'Mobile app', a chat bubble with sparkle labeled 'AI assistant', and a server labeled 'PMS'. One arrow from each into a single gate labeled 'Partner gateway'. Directly behind the gate, a shield labeled 'Authorization', with one arrow from the gate into it. Right side, four service boxes stacked: a house card labeled 'Listings', a calendar labeled 'ARI', a confirmation slip labeled 'Reservations', and a coin stack labeled 'Finance'. One arrow from 'Authorization' into each of the four service boxes.
alt: Extranet, mobile app, AI assistant and PMS all pass through one partner gateway and authorization before reaching listings, ARI, reservations and finance.

visual_goal: Show a reservation exception as a work item that is claimed and resolved, or escalated to the marketplace when the deadline approaches with no owner.
prompt: A state map of four rounded tiles. Left: a tile with an inbox tray labeled 'Open'. Top middle: a tile with a hand holding a card labeled 'Claimed'. Bottom middle: an orange tile with a small alarm clock labeled 'Escalated'. Right: a green tile with a checkmark labeled 'Resolved'. One arrow from 'Open' to 'Claimed' labeled 'staff takes it'. One arrow from 'Open' down to 'Escalated' labeled 'no owner'. One arrow from 'Claimed' to 'Resolved'. One arrow from 'Claimed' down to 'Escalated' labeled 'deadline passed'. One arrow from 'Escalated' to 'Resolved' labeled 'marketplace acts'.
alt: An exception moves from Open to Claimed and Resolved, or to Escalated when there is no owner or the deadline passes, and the marketplace resolves escalated items.

visual_goal: Show delegation as data: a grant linking an owner, a delegate and a target with a role and validity, read by the authorization check, with money roles granted separately on the target.
prompt: A hub-and-spoke illustration. In the center, a large card with a ribbon seal labeled 'Grant'. On the left, a person icon labeled 'Owner', with one arrow into the card labeled 'grants'. On the right, a group of a person, a building and a small gear labeled 'Delegate', with one arrow from the card to it. Below the card, a house labeled 'Target', with one arrow from the card down to it. Below 'Target', a small wallet labeled 'Money roles' attached to the target by one arrow. Above the card, two small tags attached to it: a badge labeled 'Role' and a calendar strip labeled 'Valid until'. On the far upper right, a shield labeled 'Authorization' with one dashed arrow pointing into the card labeled 'reads'.
alt: A grant card links an owner to a delegate and a target, carrying a role and validity; money roles hang on the target; authorization reads the grant.

visual_goal: Show one late check-out change rippling to three lifecycles: the reservation, the cleaner's turnover task and the lock access code.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. Far left: a generic guest figure with a phone, one arrow labeled 'later check-out' into a box labeled 'Reservation'. From 'Reservation' an arrow labeled 'altered event' splits into two branches. Upper branch: a box with a broom and calendar labeled 'Turnover task', then an arrow to a generic cleaner figure with a cart, labeled 'new start time'. Lower branch: a box with a keypad lock labeled 'Access code', with a circular refresh arrow beside it labeled 'reissued'. A return arrow from 'Reservation' back to the guest labeled 'updated details'.
alt: A guest's later check-out alters the reservation, whose event moves the cleaner's turnover task and reissues the lock access code, and the guest gets updated details.
